name: Holy Spirit The Comforter The
overview: Scripture reveals the Holy Spirit as the Comforter who imparts hope and the love of God to believers, as demonstrated in Romans 5:3-5. Through trials, the Spirit produces patience and experience, culminating in hope that does not disappoint because God's love is poured into our hearts by the Holy Ghost. This work of the Spirit confirms His intimate presence with and within the saints, communicating joy and sustaining their faith.
